What are Practice credits and AI credits?

Practice credits pay for mocks and practice sets. AI credits pay for Ask Mobi replies and repair explanations. Each has its own balance. AI credits show the date they renew. Practice credits do not renew.

On Pro, practice is unlimited. Your AI credits still count.

How do I see what I have used?

Open Account, then Credits. Every line says which credits it used, how many, and how many are left.

What is NTA mode?

NTA mode sets a paper out like the real CUET screen. The question palette, Mark for Review and the timer look and behave as they do on exam day. It comes with Pro.
